apply_blocker: DO class lifecycle: the OAuthState migration is created by this upload, so the version API cannot roll back to a pre-DO old version (DO migration state is not reverted by a version deployment). Auth apply is therefore excluded from the executable runner scope until a separately reviewed rollback story exists. Payload and runtime are checked here; NO supported-rollback claim is made.

live_migration_tag_before.evidence: discovery settings GET result contains no migrations/migration_tag fields

active_deployment.assert: result.deployments[0].id === pinned_live_deployment_id AND its versions[0].version_id === pinned_live_version_id; mismatch -> STOP (stale pin).

latest_upload.assert: the newest version id in the versions list === pinned_live_version_id AND the total count equals the pinned snapshot count; any extra/unpublished version -> STOP.

full_settings.assert: projected settings (name/type/resource-id only, readback-projection.mjs) must equal pinned full settings AND the bindings inventory must match live_bindings_inventory exactly; any UNKNOWN field in the live settings result -> STOP (no default handling).

post_deploy_readback.settings_get: allowed (secret_text/kv_namespace bindings only), value-free projection via readback-projection.mjs
post_deploy_readback.abort_rule: Active deployment must reference the new version id from the PUT response. If a FOREIGN version is active -> STOP. Settings deviations (riot/steam) -> STOP + rollback payload for this worker.

function_smoke: Local miniflare smoke only (tests/oauthstate-miniflare.test.mjs, compatibility_date 2021-11-02 — the same explicit date as this payload). Production /callback needs a live authorized flow by the operator; no secret values handled by this repo.
